title: Spartina Earth Data Asset Manifest
description: One record per data asset (scene, tile, label file, or derived product). Bytes are never committed to Git; this manifest is the traceable record. Missing values must be null or the string UNKNOWN, never guessed.

asset_id.description: Globally unique stable identifier, e.g. scene-<sceneId> or tile-<tileId>-<date>.

source.description: Acquisition channel, e.g. google_earth_engine, government_portal, partner_uav, legacy_recovery.

sensor.description: Sensor registry name (landsat5/7/8/9, sentinel1, sentinel2) or null for non-EO assets.

acquisition_time.description: ISO 8601 acquisition timestamp or date; null if not applicable.

region.description: Anonymized coastal region/segment identifier from the versioned region table.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in the declared CRS, or null.

crs.description: CRS as EPSG code (e.g. EPSG:32651) or WKT reference; null if not georeferenced.

native.description: true if data are at sensor-native resolution; false if resampled (must never be claimed native).

bands.description: Band identities actually present (registry band names).

label_type.description: Label geometry/type, or null for unlabeled assets.

label_quality.description: GOLD=field/UAV/expert; SILVER=credible government/peer-reviewed product with provenance; WEAK=index/rule/legacy auto; UNLABELED=raw EO.

license.description: License identifier or UNKNOWN. Never assume Apache for non-code data.

permission.description: Redistribution permission established for this project.

local_uri.description: Local storage URI outside Git (datasets/raw, datasets/processed), or null.

remote_uri.description: Upstream URI (GEE asset, DOI, portal URL), or null.

provenance.description: Trace chain: source scene -> preprocessing -> label/model versions.

notes.description: Free-text caveats; UNKNOWN/MISSING/TODO_VERIFY markers belong here when relevant.
